req.title: Redirect to arbitrary URL
req.statement: The system shall issue an HTTP 302 redirect to the URL given by the 'url' query parameter of /redirect-to.

doc.reasoning: The redirect_to() handler reads 'url' from query args, sets status_code=302 by default, and writes the exact URL string into the Location header. To kill mutations we must: (1) assert status_code == 302 exactly, (2) assert Location == the exact supplied URL string, (3) test the status_code override boundary (300, 399, 400 — the guard is >= 300 and < 400), (4) test that a missing 'url' param causes a 4xx/5xx error path, (5) test that a URL with special characters is preserved verbatim, and (6) test that an override status_code outside the 3xx range is ignored and 302 is returned.

tests.name: test_redirect_to_basic_302_with_exact_location
trace: R-HTTPBIN-024: status 302 and Location set to supplied url
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_basic_302_with_exact_location():
    target_url = 'https://example.com'
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=' + target_url, follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == target_url

test_redirect_to_basic_302_with_exact_location()

tests.name: test_redirect_to_location_exact_string_preserved
expected: Location header equals the exact URL with query string
trace: R-HTTPBIN-024: Location must equal the exact url parameter value
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import urllib.parse
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_location_exact_string_preserved():
    target_url = 'https://httpbin.org/get?foo=bar&baz=1'
    encoded = urllib.parse.quote(target_url, safe='')
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=' + encoded, follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == target_url

test_redirect_to_location_exact_string_preserved()

tests.name: test_redirect_to_no_follow_location_is_not_empty
expected: Location header is exactly 'http://target.example.org/path' (non-empty, exact match)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-024: Location must not be empty or altered
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_no_follow_location_is_not_empty():
    target = 'http://target.example.org/path'
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=' + target, follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    loc = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert loc == target
    assert len(loc) > 0

test_redirect_to_no_follow_location_is_not_empty()
